prototype.title: Make the next step obvious.
prototype.name: Refine a project-creation flow
prototype.description: Try the interface. Point at the confusing control. Review a revision in the same conversation.

proposal.title: Turn a proposal into a decision.
proposal.name: Improve an onboarding proposal
proposal.description: Discuss the paragraph that needs work, with the supporting files close at hand.

explanation.title: Understand it by trying it.
explanation.name: Explore how search works
explanation.description: Ask your agent for an explanation you can experiment with, then question the details.

codeReview.title: Follow the fix to the line.
codeReview.name: Fix duplicate form submissions
codeReview.description: Review an actual patch, discuss the failure case, and inspect the agent’s next publication.

media.title: Point to the exact moment.
media.name: Improve a launch campaign
media.description: Keep a saved frame and region attached to the feedback, even as the asset changes.

preciseFeedback.title: Comment on the work. Send it to your agent.
preciseFeedback.description: Click a button, heading, or input and leave a note. Collect your feedback, then send it to your agent in one batch, with the exact element and viewport context.

agentReplies.title: Follow the reply. Keep every version.
agentReplies.description: Your agent replies in the same thread and publishes revisions as new versions. Earlier versions stay available, so you can revisit the original and open the latest when you’re ready.

inspectFixes.title: See the fix, side by side.
inspectFixes.description: Once your agent publishes a revision, open Compare from the reply. Check the original beside the fix to see whether it solves the problem.

imageComments.title: Attach images in comments.
imageComments.description: Attach screenshots, sketches, or design mockups directly to your feedback to show your agent the intended design.

videoComments.title: Comment on the exact video frame.
videoComments.description: Pause anywhere in a clip, highlight a region, and leave a note. The captured timestamp and still frame give your agent unambiguous visual context.
